principle: Model opportunity selects what to explain. Field evidence determines whether management language is justified.

opportunity_threshold_pct.description: Report-program setting. It is deliberately not hard-coded in this library.

include_research_context.description: When true, research-only or unstable findings may appear in a clearly labeled research section.

gates.name: opportunity_gate
gates.pass_when: opportunity_pct >= opportunity_threshold_pct AND reportable is true
gates.purpose: Avoid attaching a nutrient appendix for trivial modeled opportunities.

gates.name: reliability_gate
gates.pass_when: support_status is validated or operational AND extrapolation is false AND stability is stable or mixed
gates.mixed_result: Attach as diagnostic_only and add the Minimum Field Data Package.
gates.fail_result: Do not present as an actionable yield opportunity. Research context may be shown only when enabled.

gates.name: interpretation_gate
gates.pass_when: required_data_for_management are present and appendix max_action_level permits management_context
gates.fail_result: Attach for diagnosis only. Do not generate a fertilizer, amendment, or irrigation prescription.

gates.name: safety_gate
gates.result: Cap automated output at diagnostic_only unless a separately reviewed rule explicitly authorizes management language.

gates.name: interaction_gate
gates.pass_when: two or more nutrient appendices are selected OR an interaction flag is present
gates.result: Attach the Nutrient Interaction and Root Zone Map. Research interactions remain non-prescriptive.

input_contract.interaction_flags: array such as KxCl or KxS
